text:
Sophia: FYI customer acct_8234 reported ~30k embedding tokens burned overnight even though they disabled the nightly job yesterday.
Kevin: Can you paste the job id and when they toggled it off? Might be a scheduler flake.
Sophia: job_id=job-20250315-37, they say they flipped off in Console at 22:10 UTC yesterday. Admin logs show the toggle but embeddings usage spikes at 23:03.
Kevin: Huh. Do we have worker logs around 23:00-23:10? If the worker didn't read the latest config it could still run. Also check for dedupe key mismatch — that would requeue.
Sophia: Pasted logs from the dedicated worker (excerpt):
```
2025-03-15T22:59:58Z worker-42 INFO Received schedule: job-20250315-37 next_run=2025-03-15T23:00:00Z
2025-03-15T23:00:01Z worker-42 INFO Launching batch_embed request trace=tr_0a1b2c
2025-03-15T23:00:02Z worker-42 ERROR Failed to fetch cached payload, continuing
2025-03-15T23:00:03Z worker-42 INFO Submitted 1200 items -> /v1/embeddings (model: revembed-2)
2025-03-15T23:00:04Z client-remote WARN Received 429, scheduling retry backoff=2s
2025-03-15T23:00:06Z worker-42 INFO Retry submit attempt=1 trace=tr_0a1b2c
2025-03-15T23:00:07Z worker-42 INFO Submitted 1200 items -> /v1/embeddings (model: revembed-2)
```
Sophia: Looks like it retried and sent twice. They had dedupe disabled in their job config (they unchecked "enable idempotency") — user error but the toggle being off in Console should have prevented the schedule from firing.
Kevin: If console wrote the toggle but the schedule persisted in the job manifest (old-format vs new-format) our scheduler might have ignored it. I'll check the job manifest stored in S3/manifest-store for that job_id.
Alex: Also note the batch size is huge — 1200 items. That amplifies cost when duplicates happen. We should recommend a smaller batch or idempotency.
Maria: From billing side: customer emailed upset, asking for refund of credits for the extra 2x run. Please provide estimated tokens consumed and timeframe so we can process a credit.
Sophia: Estimated extra = ~30k embedding tokens (~$12) and some per-request overhead. Customer on free-trial grant (trial_2025Q1) — need to ensure we don't exhaust their trial balance.
Kevin: Found manifest diff: their console toggle updated `enabled: false` in the UI-layer record, but the active manifest in manifest-store still had `enabled: true` due to a failed manifest refresh last night (manifest-refresh lambda timed out). The scheduler reads manifest-store. So schedule fired.
Kevin: Fix: 1) Force-refresh manifest-store for job-20250315-37 2) Patch manifest-refresh lambda timeout config 3) Add a guard that checks last-updated timestamp vs UI toggle timestamp before executing a scheduled run.
Alex: Temporary mitigation: I've paused the dedicated worker queue for that customer's org_id (org_8234) — that will stop further runs. Also recommend we add a cheap dedupe check on ingestion to avoid double-sends.
sre-bot: Automated trace attached: https://traces.internal/redwood/trace/tr_0a1b2c (shows two /v1/embeddings calls within 5s)
Maria: Billing: please confirm exact token count and whether the trial top-up can cover this. If not, we'll issue a one-off credit. Tagging @billing-bot to create a ticket.
billing-bot: Ticket created: BL-7892 for acct_8234, requestor=Sophia, amount_estimate="$15", status=pending_review
Sophia: I've notified the customer that we've paused their jobs, opened a billing ticket, and are investigating root cause. They asked for a full rollback of charges if we confirm a platform bug.
Kevin: Root cause triage done; plan to deploy patch to manifest-refresh lambda tomorrow 03:00 UTC and add the guard in scheduler. I'll post PR when ready.
Alex: I'll follow up with a doc snippet for "how to cancel scheduled jobs" and highlight the UI vs manifest inconsistency so other users don't get surprised.
Maria: If engineering confirms platform bug, billing will issue credit immediately. Otherwise we'll offer a partial goodwill credit for the inconvenience.
Sophia: Thanks — wrapping up: actions = pause queue (done), billing ticket created, manifest refresh forced, patch planned. I'll update acct_8234 after PR deploy.
Kevin: Marking this thread for postmortem if manifest-refresh timeout recurs. :clipboard:
Sophia: Thanks all :thumbsup:"
